_comment: Pronunciation lexicon for Video I (narration skill, PRONUNCIATION.md). Names from the P3 claim walk (CloudyFinch, mx-e-a-dza.5), probed with probe_names.py run --voice michael on 2026-10-13; each probe.verdict says what the ASR heard. Paul Curry and Martin Gardner are plain English and not listed. The owner's pronunciation overrides every entry.

Nicomachus.note: Nicomachus of Gerasa (06_5). Wikipedia gives Latin IPA only; English usage nih-KOM-uh-kus.

probe.date: 2026-10-13, michael, ftts 0.1.11, fw 0.10.0, 3 carriers, control + decoy (probe_names.py run)
probe.verdict: Plain word heard as Nicomachus 3/3; nih-KOM-uh-kus was garbled (Night Come A Cuss). The decoy was also heard as the name once, so the vowel is for the owner's ear.

Al-Karaji.note: Abu Bakr al-Karaji (06_6). No IPA in the sources; candidates from the Arabic.

probe.date: 2026-10-13, michael, ftts 0.1.11, fw 0.10.0, 3 carriers, control + decoy (probe_names.py run)
probe.verdict: Plain spelling heard as Al Karaji / Al-Qaraji 3/3 (the right sounds); both respellings were worse. For the owner's ear.

Siu.note: Man-Keung Siu (08_5, 15_5 'Siu's'), Cantonese surname 蕭 (Siu). No written source; for the owner's ear.

probe.date: 2026-10-13, michael, ftts 0.1.11, fw 0.10.0, 3 carriers, control + decoy (probe_names.py run)
probe.verdict: Plain spelling heard as 'See you' / CU, the Cantonese siu (see-oo) as one syllable pair; SEE-oo was read as letters. PASS by the tool; for the owner's ear.

Man-Keung.note: Man-Keung Siu's given name (08_5). For the owner's ear.

probe.date: 2026-10-13, michael, ftts 0.1.11, fw 0.10.0, 3 carriers, control + decoy (probe_names.py run)
probe.verdict: PARTIAL: no reading verified; the plain spelling is heard as Meng Kung / Mang Kung, near the Cantonese man keung, and the respellings were worse. For the owner's ear.

Archimedes.note: 11_6. Wikipedia's US IPA; lookup_pronunciation.py misread the grc-x-doric tag (CloudyFinch), do not use its output.

probe.date: 2026-10-13, michael, ftts 0.1.11, fw 0.10.0, 3 carriers, control + decoy (probe_names.py run)
probe.verdict: Plain word heard as Archimedes 3/3; ar-kih-MEE-deez was garbled once.

Ajose.note: Sunday Ajose (11_6), Yoruba surname. No written source; for the owner's ear.

probe.date: 2026-10-13, michael, ftts 0.1.11, fw 0.10.0, 3 carriers, control + decoy (probe_names.py run)
probe.verdict: PARTIAL: the plain spelling is misread (a Jost, ajos); ah-JOH-seh is heard as 'Ah, Jose', the intended sounds. Yoruba tones not modelled; for the owner's ear.

probe.date: 2026-10-13, michael, ftts 0.1.11, fw 0.10.0, 3 carriers, control + decoy (probe_names.py run)
probe.verdict: Plain word heard as Nelson 3/3 (the same sound).

Pythagoras.note: 'Pythagoras's' in the script; the plain word.

probe.date: 2026-10-13, michael, ftts 0.1.11, fw 0.10.0, 3 carriers, control + decoy (probe_names.py run)
probe.verdict: Plain word heard as Pythagoras 3/3; the respelling was garbled.
